intro: The Book from Sven's Farm is a dirt-stained, untitled journal unearthed from the ruins of Sven Yorgen's ransacked homestead in Duskwood. Its fragmented entries reveal that an unknown onlooker witnessed the massacre of Sven's family, sparking a relentless hunt across the shadowed woods.

p: Buried in a loose dirt mound amid the charred remains of Sven's farm in southern Duskwood, this unassuming, weather-damaged volume contains the frantic notes of an anonymous wanderer. The entries offer incomplete glimpses into the tragedy that struck the farmstead, confirming Sven Yorgen's darkest suspicion: someone lurked in the shadows while his family was slain. Because the narrative cuts off abruptly, the book raises more questions than answers, prompting investigators to carry it back to Darkshire in search of anyone who recognizes the handwriting or its enigmatic author.
